name: whetstone
description: Plan, outline and tutor source-grounded courses: learner profile, material triage, course-by-course plan, confirmed outlines, per-unit documents, section-by-section active reconstruction with an append-only learner log.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, outline and tutor source-grounded courses.
interface.longDescription: Analyze user-supplied documents, repositories, and exported conversations; identify material-specific prerequisite dependencies; assess the learner one question at a time; research cited supplements for actual gaps; then create and teach a problem-driven course with traceable evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $learn to learn these materials. Fill in whatever planning is missing, confirm the outline with me, then teach one unit at a time.
Use $guide — I am new to this, or I want to (re)plan my goals, background and course sequence for this directory of materials.
Use $outline to show or revise the outline of courses/<id>/.
Resume my course from the saved progress.
Use $clarify to expand the unresolved [[concepts]] in my lesson pack into source-grounded concept notes.
